title: The next outbreak? We’re not ready | Bill Gates | TED

blocks.en_text: When I was a kid,
blocks.zh_text: 我小的时候，

blocks.en_text: the disaster we worried about most was a nuclear war.
blocks.zh_text: 我们最担心的灾难是核战争。

blocks.en_text: That's why we had a barrel like this down in our basement,
blocks.zh_text: 所以我们在自家地下室放了一个这样的桶，

blocks.en_text: filled with cans of food and water.
blocks.zh_text: 里面装满了罐头食品和水。

blocks.en_text: When the nuclear attack came,
blocks.zh_text: 核攻击来的时候，

blocks.en_text: we were supposed to go downstairs, hunker down, and eat out of that barrel.
blocks.zh_text: 我们应该下楼，躲起来，靠那个桶里的东西过活。

blocks.en_text: Today the greatest risk of global catastrophe
blocks.zh_text: 如今全球灾难的最大风险

blocks.en_text: doesn't look like this.
blocks.zh_text: 看起来并不是这样。

blocks.en_text: Instead, it looks like this.
blocks.zh_text: 而是这样。

blocks.en_text: If anything kills over 10 million people in the next few decades,
blocks.zh_text: 如果未来几十年里有东西能杀死超过一千万人，

blocks.en_text: it's most likely to be a highly infectious virus
blocks.zh_text: 那最可能是一种高度传染性的病毒，

blocks.en_text: rather than a war.
blocks.zh_text: 而不是战争。

blocks.en_text: Not missiles, but microbes.
blocks.zh_text: 不是导弹，而是微生物。

blocks.en_text: Now, part of the reason for this is that
blocks.zh_text: 造成这种情况的部分原因是，

blocks.en_text: we've invested a huge amount in nuclear deterrents.
blocks.zh_text: 我们在核威慑上投入了巨额资金。

blocks.en_text: But we've actually invested very little in a system to stop an epidemic.
blocks.zh_text: 但我们在阻止流行病的系统上投入其实非常少。

blocks.en_text: We're not ready for the next epidemic.
blocks.zh_text: 我们还没准备好应对下一场流行病。

blocks.en_text: Let's look at Ebola.
blocks.zh_text: 我们来看看埃博拉。

blocks.en_text: I'm sure all of you read about it in the newspaper,
blocks.zh_text: 我相信你们都在报纸上读到过，

blocks.en_text: lots of tough challenges.
blocks.zh_text: 有很多严峻的挑战。

blocks.en_text: I followed it carefully through the case analysis tools
blocks.zh_text: 我用病例分析工具仔细跟踪了它，

blocks.en_text: we use to track polio eradication.
blocks.zh_text: 就是我们用来追踪脊髓灰质炎根除的那些工具。

blocks.en_text: And as you look at what went on,
blocks.zh_text: 当你看看当时发生的情况，

blocks.en_text: the problem wasn't that there was a system that didn't work well enough,
blocks.zh_text: 问题并不是有个系统运转得不够好，

blocks.en_text: the problem was that we didn't have a system at all.
blocks.zh_text: 问题是我们根本没有系统。

blocks.en_text: In fact, there's some pretty obvious key missing pieces.
blocks.zh_text: 事实上，有几个相当明显的关键缺失环节。

blocks.en_text: We didn't have a group of epidemiologists ready to go, who would have gone,
blocks.zh_text: 我们没有一支随时待命的流行病学家队伍，他们本可以赶过去，

blocks.en_text: seen what the disease was, seen how far it had spread.
blocks.zh_text: 看看这是什么病，看看它已经传播了多远。

blocks.en_text: The case reports came in on paper.
blocks.zh_text: 病例报告是写在纸上送来的。

blocks.en_text: It was very delayed before they were put online
blocks.zh_text: 它们被放到网上之前拖了很久，

blocks.en_text: and they were extremely inaccurate.
blocks.zh_text: 而且极不准确。

blocks.en_text: We didn't have a medical team ready to go.
blocks.zh_text: 我们没有一支随时待命的医疗队。

blocks.en_text: We didn't have a way of preparing people.
blocks.zh_text: 我们没有一套让人们做好准备的办法。

blocks.en_text: Now, Médecins Sans Frontières did a great job orchestrating volunteers.
blocks.zh_text: 无国界医生在组织志愿者方面做得非常出色。

blocks.en_text: But even so, we were far slower than we should have been
blocks.zh_text: 但即便如此，我们的速度也远远慢于应有的水平，

blocks.en_text: getting the thousands of workers into these countries.
blocks.zh_text: 把成千上万的工人送进这些国家。

blocks.en_text: And a large epidemic would require us to have hundreds of thousands of workers.
blocks.zh_text: 而一场大规模流行病会需要我们拥有几十万名工作人员。

blocks.en_text: There was no one there to look at treatment approaches.
blocks.zh_text: 那里没有人去研究治疗方法。

blocks.en_text: No one to look at the diagnostics.
blocks.zh_text: 没有人去看诊断方法。

blocks.en_text: No one to figure out what tools should be used.
blocks.zh_text: 没有人去弄清楚该用什么工具。

blocks.en_text: As an example, we could have taken the blood of survivors,
blocks.zh_text: 举个例子，我们本可以抽取幸存者的血液，

blocks.en_text: processed it, and put that plasma back in people to protect them.
blocks.zh_text: 处理一下，再把那些血浆输回人体内来保护他们。

blocks.en_text: But that was never tried.
blocks.zh_text: 但这从来没有被尝试过。

blocks.en_text: So there was a lot that was missing.
blocks.zh_text: 所以，当时缺的东西有很多。

blocks.en_text: And these things are really a global failure.
blocks.zh_text: 而这些事情真的是全球性的失败。

blocks.en_text: The WHO is funded to monitor epidemics, but not to do these things I talked about.
blocks.zh_text: 世卫组织获得的资金是用来监测流行病的，而不是来做我刚才说的那些事情的。

blocks.en_text: Now, in the movies it's quite different.
blocks.zh_text: 而在电影里，情况就大不一样了。

blocks.en_text: There's a group of handsome epidemiologists ready to go,
blocks.zh_text: 有一群英俊的流行病学家随时待命，

blocks.en_text: they move in, they save the day, but that's just pure Hollywood.
blocks.zh_text: 他们赶赴现场，力挽狂澜，但那纯粹是好莱坞的桥段。

blocks.en_text: The failure to prepare could allow the next epidemic
blocks.zh_text: 准备工作的缺失可能会让下一场流行病

blocks.en_text: to be dramatically more devastating than Ebola
blocks.zh_text: 变得比埃博拉严重得多、破坏性大得多。

blocks.en_text: Let's look at the progression of Ebola over this year.
blocks.zh_text: 我们来看看今年埃博拉的发展过程。

blocks.en_text: About 10,000 people died,
blocks.zh_text: 大约有一万人死亡，

blocks.en_text: and nearly all were in the three West African countries.
blocks.zh_text: 而且几乎都集中在三个西非国家。

blocks.en_text: There's three reasons why it didn't spread more.
blocks.zh_text: 它没有扩散得更广，原因有三个。

blocks.en_text: The first is that there was a lot of heroic work by the health workers.
blocks.zh_text: 第一，医护人员做了大量英勇的工作。

blocks.en_text: They found the people and they prevented more infections.
blocks.zh_text: 他们找到了感染者，防止了更多感染。

blocks.en_text: The second is the nature of the virus.
blocks.zh_text: 第二是这个病毒本身的性质。

blocks.en_text: Ebola does not spread through the air.
blocks.zh_text: 埃博拉不通过空气传播。

blocks.en_text: And by the time you're contagious,
blocks.zh_text: 而且等到你有传染性的时候，

blocks.en_text: most people are so sick that they're bedridden.
blocks.zh_text: 大多数人已经病得很重，只能卧床不起。

blocks.en_text: Third, it didn't get into many urban areas.
blocks.zh_text: 第三，它没有进入很多城市地区。

blocks.en_text: And that was just luck.
blocks.zh_text: 而这纯粹是运气。

blocks.en_text: If it had gotten into a lot more urban areas,
blocks.zh_text: 如果它进入了多得多的城市地区，

blocks.en_text: the case numbers would have been much larger.
blocks.zh_text: 病例数会大得多。

blocks.en_text: So next time, we might not be so lucky.
blocks.zh_text: 所以下一次，我们可能就没这么幸运了。

blocks.en_text: You can have a virus where people feel well enough while they're infectious
blocks.zh_text: 可能会有这样一种病毒，人们被感染时还感觉良好，

blocks.en_text: that they get on a plane or they go to a market.
blocks.zh_text: 以至于他们会登上飞机，或者去逛市场。

blocks.en_text: The source of the virus could be a natural epidemic like Ebola,
blocks.zh_text: 病毒的来源可能是像埃博拉这样的自然流行病，

blocks.en_text: or it could be bioterrorism.
blocks.zh_text: 也可能是生物恐怖主义。

blocks.en_text: So there are things that would literally make things a thousand times worse.
blocks.zh_text: 所以有些情况真的会让事态糟糕一千倍。

blocks.en_text: In fact, let's look at a model of a virus spread through the air,
blocks.zh_text: 事实上，我们来看一个通过空气传播的病毒模型，

blocks.en_text: like the Spanish Flu back in 1918.
blocks.zh_text: 就像1918年的西班牙流感那样。

blocks.en_text: So here's what would happen:
blocks.zh_text: 情况会是这样：

blocks.en_text: It would spread throughout the world very, very quickly.
blocks.zh_text: 它会非常非常快地传遍全世界。

blocks.en_text: And you can see over 30 million people died from that epidemic.
blocks.zh_text: 你可以看到，那场流行病导致三千多万人死亡。

blocks.en_text: So this is a serious problem.
blocks.zh_text: 所以这是一个严重的问题。

blocks.en_text: We should be concerned.
blocks.zh_text: 我们应该感到担忧。

blocks.en_text: But in fact, we can build a really good response system.
blocks.zh_text: 但事实上，我们可以建立一个非常好的应对系统。

blocks.en_text: We have the benefits of all the science and technology that we talk about here.
blocks.zh_text: 我们拥有这里所谈到的所有科学和技术带来的好处。

blocks.en_text: We've got cell phones
blocks.zh_text: 我们有手机，

blocks.en_text: to get information from the public and get information out to them.
blocks.zh_text: 可以从公众那里获取信息，也能把信息传达给他们。

blocks.en_text: We have satellite maps where we can see where people are and where they're moving.
blocks.zh_text: 我们有卫星地图，可以看到人们在哪里、往哪里移动。

blocks.en_text: We have advances in biology
blocks.zh_text: 我们在生物学上也有进步

blocks.en_text: that should dramatically change the turnaround time to look at a pathogen
blocks.zh_text: 这应该会大幅缩短研究病原体的周转时间

blocks.en_text: and be able to make drugs and vaccines that fit for that pathogen.
blocks.zh_text: 并且能够研制出针对那种病原体的药物和疫苗。

blocks.en_text: So we can have tools,
blocks.zh_text: 所以我们能有工具，

blocks.en_text: but those tools need to be put into an overall global health system.
blocks.zh_text: 但这些工具需要被纳入一个整体的全球卫生体系。

blocks.en_text: And we need preparedness.
blocks.zh_text: 而且我们需要做好准备。

blocks.en_text: The best lessons, I think, on how to get prepared
blocks.zh_text: 我认为，关于如何做好准备的最好经验

blocks.en_text: are again, what we do for war.
blocks.zh_text: 还是我们为战争所做的那些。

blocks.en_text: For soldiers, we have full-time, waiting to go.
blocks.zh_text: 对于士兵，我们有全职的，随时待命出发。

blocks.en_text: We have reserves that can scale us up to large numbers.
blocks.zh_text: 我们有预备役，可以扩充到很大的数量。

blocks.en_text: NATO has a mobile unit that can deploy very rapidly.
blocks.zh_text: 北约有一支机动部队，可以非常迅速地部署。

blocks.en_text: NATO does a lot of war games to check, are people well trained?
blocks.zh_text: 北约做很多军事演习来检查，人员训练得好不好？

blocks.en_text: Do they understand about fuel and logistics
blocks.zh_text: 他们懂不懂燃料和后勤

blocks.en_text: and the same radio frequencies?
blocks.zh_text: 以及相同的无线电频率？

blocks.en_text: So they are absolutely ready to go.
blocks.zh_text: 所以他们完全准备好出发了。

blocks.en_text: So those are the kinds of things we need to deal with an epidemic.
blocks.zh_text: 这些就是我们应对流行病所需要的那类东西。

blocks.en_text: What are the key pieces?
blocks.zh_text: 关键的部分有哪些？

blocks.en_text: First, we need strong health systems in poor countries.
blocks.zh_text: 第一，我们需要在贫困国家建立强大的卫生系统。

blocks.en_text: That's where mothers can give birth safely,
blocks.zh_text: 在那里母亲可以安全分娩，

blocks.en_text: kids can get all their vaccines.
blocks.zh_text: 孩子们能接种所有疫苗。

blocks.en_text: But, also where we'll see the outbreak very early on.
blocks.zh_text: 但同时，我们也能在那里很早就发现疫情。

blocks.en_text: We need a medical reserve corps:
blocks.zh_text: 我们需要一支医疗预备队：

blocks.en_text: lots of people who've got the training and background
blocks.zh_text: 很多受过训练、有背景的人

blocks.en_text: who are ready to go, with the expertise.
blocks.zh_text: 随时准备出发，带着专业知识。

blocks.en_text: And then we need to pair those medical people with the military.
blocks.zh_text: 然后我们需要把这些医疗人员和军队配对，

blocks.en_text: taking advantage of the military's ability to move fast, do logistics
blocks.zh_text: 利用军队快速行动、做后勤

blocks.en_text: and secure areas.
blocks.zh_text: 以及保障区域安全的能力。

blocks.en_text: We need to do simulations,
blocks.zh_text: 我们需要做模拟演练，

blocks.en_text: germ games, not war games, so that we see where the holes are.
blocks.zh_text: 是病菌演练，不是军事演习，这样我们就能看到漏洞在哪里。

blocks.en_text: The last time a germ game was done in the United States
blocks.zh_text: 美国上一次做病菌演练

blocks.en_text: was back in 2001, and it didn't go so well.
blocks.zh_text: 还是在2001年，而且进行得不太顺利。

blocks.en_text: So far the score is germs: 1, people: 0.
blocks.zh_text: 到目前为止比分是病菌：1，人类：0。

blocks.en_text: Finally, we need lots of advanced R&D in areas of vaccines and diagnostics.
blocks.zh_text: 最后，我们需要在疫苗和诊断领域进行大量先进的研发。

blocks.en_text: There are some big breakthroughs, like the Adeno-associated virus,
blocks.zh_text: 有一些重大突破，比如腺相关病毒，

blocks.en_text: that could work very, very quickly.
blocks.zh_text: 它可以非常非常快地起作用。

blocks.en_text: Now I don't have an exact budget for what this would cost,
blocks.zh_text: 现在我没有确切的预算说这要花多少钱，

blocks.en_text: but I'm quite sure it's very modest compared to the potential harm.
blocks.zh_text: 但我很确定，与潜在的危害相比，这非常有限。

blocks.en_text: The World Bank estimates that if we have a worldwide flu epidemic,
blocks.zh_text: 世界银行估计，如果我们发生全球性流感疫情，

blocks.en_text: global wealth will go down by over three trillion dollars
blocks.zh_text: 全球财富将减少超过三万亿美元

blocks.en_text: and we'd have millions and millions of deaths.
blocks.zh_text: 而且我们会有数以百万计、数以百万计的死亡。

blocks.en_text: These investments offer significant benefits
blocks.zh_text: 这些投资带来显著的益处

blocks.en_text: beyond just being ready for the epidemic.
blocks.zh_text: 远不止是让我们为流行病做好准备。

blocks.en_text: The primary healthcare, the R&D,
blocks.zh_text: 基础医疗、研发，

blocks.en_text: those things would reduce global health equity
blocks.zh_text: 这些做法会减少全球健康不平等

blocks.en_text: and make the world more just as well as more safe.
blocks.zh_text: 让世界不仅更安全，也更加公平。

blocks.en_text: So I think this should absolutely be a priority.
blocks.zh_text: 所以我认为这绝对应该成为一项优先事项。

blocks.en_text: There's no need to panic.
blocks.zh_text: 没必要恐慌。

blocks.en_text: We don't have to hoard cans of spaghetti or go down into the basement.
blocks.zh_text: 我们不必囤积一罐罐意大利面，也不用躲进地下室。

blocks.en_text: But we need to get going, because time is not on our side.
blocks.zh_text: 但我们需要行动起来，因为时间不等人。

blocks.en_text: In fact, if there's one positive thing that can come out of the Ebola epidemic,
blocks.zh_text: 事实上，如果说埃博拉疫情能带来一件积极的事，

blocks.en_text: it's that it can serve as an early warning, a wake-up call, to get ready.
blocks.zh_text: 那就是它可以充当一个预警、一次警钟，让我们做好准备。

blocks.en_text: If we start now, we can be ready for the next epidemic.
blocks.zh_text: 如果我们现在就开始，就能为下一次疫情做好准备。

blocks.en_text: Thank you.
blocks.zh_text: 谢谢。
